title: Electrical voltage gain is not net energy gain
scopeRevision: User steering to electricity, magnetism and antigravity after R2. Acoustic R3 producer/check artifacts parked without review/admission and excluded from authorized count.
incomingEvidence: Electrical continuation of explicit witness/budget principles; earlier atlas round1 already established passive mechanical energy accounting. New target is electrical readout and source-off boundary errors, not novelty of conservation.
question: Can an electrically resonant circuit show capacitor voltage amplification and source-off load work while its complete source/storage/loss budget remains passive?
computation: Integrate q,I only with a high-accuracy solver; independently integrate sampled electrical powers with trapezoidal quadrature. Do not integrate work as the same solver state used to assert closure. Split or exactly align source-off boundary.
controls: resonant driven10periods then source-off5periods: voltage gain >1.5 during late driven cycles while full energy closes
off-resonance omega=500rad/s comparison with same1V amplitude, report gain/load power
source-off initially charged C at1V: zero source input but positive load work equals released initial energy minus internal loss
wrong boundary calculation excludes stored energy and displays apparent source-off surplus; full boundary removes it
steady-state phasor control: capacitor mean real power0 but Vc_rms I_rms >0; do not call reactive VA watts
zero source and zero initial state remain zero
stronger totalR=10ohm lowers resonant voltage gain

acceptance.quadratureRefinementRequired: closure residual at400samples/period < residual at100samples/period unless already below1e-10 J

falsifier: Complete energy budget does not converge within tolerance, or voltage/VA/source-off output is interpreted as energy production.
claimCeiling: Known lumped passive circuit model and demonstrated accounting/readout counterexamples; no physical device, overunity, gravitational effect or circuit-component calibration.
loopA: Execute circuit, electrical readouts and intentional omitted-storage control.
loopB: Independent phasor/closed-form or alternate integration checks and energy boundary attack before admission.
